analyses.content: 录音中明确提到这个网站里有一个用来“定制地图的工具（facility）”，这直接对应选项C中的“有用的工具（useful tool）”。
你可能会因为不认识“facility”在这里作“工具/功能”的意思，或者没听懂“tailor-made maps（定制地图）”而不敢选，这里要注意听具体的功能描述词。
There was National Geographic. The thing there that struck me was a facility for creating tailor-made maps. We might like to use that when it comes to presenting our findings.
录音提到网站虽然有用的东西很多，但“无法获取（couldn't get at it）”，因为“只对订阅者开放（subscribers only）”，完美对应选项A的“信息不能免费获取”。
你可能会因为刚听到“masses of useful stuff”就以为是个非常好的网站而去选正面评价，要注意捕捉紧跟其后的转折词“only”，不能只听一半。
Also, I checked out the United Nations website. That one had masses of useful stuff, only I couldn't get at it. I know. It was for subscribers only, right?
录音指出该网站有一些人口数据，但“似乎没有任何能源使用的数据（didn't seem to be any figures for energy use）”，对应选项G的“缺失了部分信息（missing）”。
你可能会听到前面讲有“population statistics”就觉得信息全面，但关键在转折词“but”之后指出了数据缺失，这里考查的是对转折后核心信息的识别。

I looked at the website of an agency called the Energy Information Administration. There were some population statistics there that we could use, but there didn't seem to be any figures for energy use...
录音提到尽管数据很多，但“深入程度超出了我们作业的需要（went into more depth than was necessary）”，同义替换就是选项B的“过于详细（too detailed）”。
你可能会因为听到“lots of data”就跑去选其他正面选项，一定要注意听标志性短语“the only thing is（唯一的问题是）”后面引出的缺点描述。

I thought the British Petroleum website might be a good place to get information about energy use. Oh, good thinking. There was lots of data, actually. Uh, the only thing is, it went into more depth than was necessary for our assignment...
男生强调这是他看的唯一一个包含“今年当前数据（data for this current year）”的地方，这直接对应选项E的“最新信息（up-to-date information）”。
你可能会漏听“this current year”，或者在脑海中没有迅速把“当前年份”和选项里的“up-to-date（最新）”画上等号，要注意这种典型的同义替换。
I also looked on the Central Intelligence Agency website. ... Something worth noting: it seemed to be the only place I looked at that had data for this current year.
录音提到这个网站的数据“可以追溯到很久以前（going back quite a long way）”，这直接对应了选项H的“历史信息（historical information）”。
你可能对“going back quite a long way”这种口语化表达反应不过来，在听力中这通常就是表示历史（historical）或过往数据的固定替换方式。
And I also found stuff on the World Bank site, and that had figures going back quite a long way.

questions.question: Which TWO decisions do the students reach about the subject matter of their assignment?

analyses.content: 两人反复强调不要贪多嚼不烂，并同意“限制（limit）”数据范围以及把国家范围“进一步缩小（narrowed it down further）”，对应选项B的“限制调查规模（limit the scale）”。
你可能会因为听到录音提到了“final assessment”（48句）或者“North and South America”（53句）而错选A或C，但录音实际说的是“不计入最终成绩”且“缩小了原来美洲的范围”，没跟上语义就会被原词干扰。

I think one thing we've got to be careful about is biting off more than we can chew. ... So, shall we just limit it to data about population size and energy consumption? ... But in that case, we originally planned to stick to countries in North and South America, but what if we narrowed it down further?

questions.question: Which TWO decisions do the students reach about the subject matter of their assignment?

analyses.content: 录音中提议研究20个国家，明确分为“能源消耗前10名”和“最后10名”这两组并达成一致，完美对应选项D的“收集两组国家的数据”。
你可能会听到男生花了一大段（58-59句）讨论风能、核能而错选E，但紧接着女生在第60句说“But we did just agree to restrict our data”，直接把这个想法给否决了，多选题一定要听到对方“同意”才算数。

How about, let's say, twenty countries in all, the top ten consumers of energy in the region, and also the bottom ten? Mm, sounds good. ... (中间男生提议加风能核能) ... But we did just agree to restrict our data.

questions.question: Which TWO tasks will Charley be responsible for?

analyses.content: Charlie主动表示自己数学不好，所以他来负责“搜索所有需要的原始数据（search out all of the raw data we need）”，对应选项B的“收集基础数据（collecting basic figures）”。
你可能会听到原词“number crunching（处理数据）”就激动地错选D，但Charlie明确说这是要求对方（if you're prepared to do）去做的工作，千万别搞错任务的分配对象。

One last thing, Charlie, and then we better go away and get started. Who's going to do what? Your math is better than mine, so I'll volunteer to search out all of the raw data we need if you're prepared to do the necessary number crunching.

questions.question: Which TWO tasks will Charley be responsible for?

analyses.content: Delia自己接下了图表工作后，询问Charlie是否介意“处理文字部分（doing the text）”，Charlie随后答应了（That's okay with me），这对应选项E的“起草文字部分”。
你可能会听到“graphics”或“look over everything”就想选C或A，但图表是Delia自己接下的（I'll take those on），而最终检查（look over everything）也是Charlie在第80句提要求让Delia去做的。
And I tell you what, since the graphics were my idea, I'll take those on. But do you mind doing the text? You've got a better way with words than I have. That's okay with me...
